[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/44db07481d5a58c1516288e86707b05a5e501c0f.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Dear pioneers,[/p][p]
today we’d like to share a first image from the current stage of development. It gives you an impression of what we’re working on right now and how the project is progressing step by step.[/p][p]
Over the coming weeks, we’ll release more visual sneak peeks so you can follow the progress directly. In addition, we’re planning to share early gameplay scenes. This will allow us to gather your feedback at an early stage and align development more closely with the community.[/p][p]
Stay tuned, we’ll keep you updated on a regular basis.[/p][p]

— The G.E.T. Team[/p]

notes.title: Community Update – What’s Been Going On & What’s Next
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/13287e419b3b52841618dc738eecb562db3607c8.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear pioneers, 

since our last post, we’ve been busy behind the scenes. We took a deep dive into the current state of G.E.T. and carefully reviewed everything you shared with us during the demo. Every bug report, every piece of feedback, and every suggestion was logged and discussed. These insights are now the backbone of our work on the Alpha. At the same time, we’ve mapped out a clear roadmap for what’s essential in the next stage of development. We’ve identified five core systems that will define the Alpha and set the stage for the full game.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Age Progression System[/b][/u] [/h3][p]Progressing through ages is more than just “unlocking the next tier.”[/p][list][*][p]Each new era comes with meaningful tasks[/p][/*][*][p]New opportunities open up as you advance[/p][/*][*][p]Fresh challenges emerge to keep things engaging [/p][/*][/list][p]We want this system to feel rewarding and impactful - not just like checking boxes.[/p][h3]
[u][b]AI System[/b][/u][/h3][p]Exploration should feel alive. Our AI isn’t just about fighting or farming - it’s about creating encounters that feel purposeful and worth your time. The full system is too large to complete for Alpha, but you’ll already see the first foundations in action.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Building System[/b][/u][/h3][p]From a simple campfire to complex machines and custom homes, the building system will give you tools to create your own space in the world of G.E.T..[/p][list][*][p]Build, upgrade, and customize[/p][/*][*][p]Add furniture and decoration for personality[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][u][b]Character System[/b][/u][/h3][p]Your character is the heart of your journey. This system covers:[/p][list][*][p]Crafting[/p][/*][*][p]Items and equipment[/p][/*][*][p]Core progression features [/p][/*][/list][p]It’s all about giving you options and freedom in how you play.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]Environment[/b][/u][/h3][p]The demo’s world was just a placeholder. With the Alpha, we want to give you a glimpse of the real vision:[/p][list][*][p]Distinct biomes with their own pros, cons, and challenges[/p][/*][*][p]A world that feels alive and worth exploring[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][u][b]Looking Ahead[/b][/u][/h3][p]Yes, this is a lot of work, but we’re not starting from scratch. After the demo, we kept developing and have already made solid progress. [/p][p]We’re fully committed to pushing forward with everything we’ve got. After the long break, it feels good to finally move again and we’re convinced the wait will be worth it.[/p][p][/p][h3][u][b]What’s Next for You[/b][/u][/h3][p]We’ll continue to keep you updated with:[/p][list][*][p]Regular text updates like this one[/p][/*][*][p]Visual sneak peeks from development[/p][/*][*][p]Opportunities to give feedback as systems take shape[/p][/*][/list][p]Your input will directly help us refine these features, because G.E.T. should be just as much your game as it is ours. Thanks for sticking with us. Onward to Alpha![/p][p][/p][p]— The G.E.T. Team[/p]

notes.title: G.E.T. is back!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/b2f6a7b33d56e2ddc7eafb50fb9402c35754ad50.jpg"][/img]Dear pioneers, 

As many of you have likely noticed – either directly or between the lines – development on G.E.T. had come to a halt. Unfortunately, not in the way we intended, and certainly not with the level of transparency we’ve always strived for. The sudden pause caught even us off guard, and we failed to properly communicate what was happening. [/p][p][b]For that, we sincerely apologize.[/b] [/p][p]Life threw us some unexpected challenges that forced us to shift our priorities quickly and decisively. Continuing development wasn’t possible under those circumstances, and putting G.E.T. on hold was one of the hardest decisions we had to make. But now, we’re happy to say: things have changed. 

[b]We’re back. And this time, with full commitment.[/b] 

Our lives have stabilized, we’re back on solid ground, and we’ve gained access to new resources that allow us to develop G.E.T. with significantly improved quality across the board – technically, visually, and structurally. 

[b]Most importantly: the core vision of G.E.T. remains the same. We’re not changing direction. But what you’ll experience going forward will be much more refined, more immersive, and far more substantial than before.[/b] 

We’re currently working hard on delivering a playable Alpha version, which will be a major leap from the old demo – not just in content, but also in functionality, polish, and atmosphere. This isn’t just about picking up where we left off – it’s about taking everything we've learned (from you and ourselves) and building something truly worthy of your time and support. To everyone who stuck with us, who asked the tough questions, who waited patiently – Thank you. We’re here. We’re building again. And this time, we’re not stopping. 

[b]Stay tuned – there’s more to come.[/b] 

— The G.E.T. Team[/p]

notes.title: Demo Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/16e5e284c82237d7ce9af862dc2feda928c60134.png[/img]

Dear pioneers,

we are hyped, that we are finally able to present you the Demo-Version of G.E.T. and hope that you are as hyped as we are finally able to test the game. 
To get access to the Demo version, you have to access our Steam site

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1903320/GET/ 

and send us a request in "Playertest" to get access to the demo. 
Your request will be accepted automatically and we hope you will have a lot of fun with the game. 

If you want to talk about what you experienced in the demo, then you can do this here on the Discord server, so that you may talk with other pioneers and give us a response about your player experience, so that we make it more enjoyable for everyone. 
Suggestions are welcome as well.

[u][b]Default key assignment of the demo:[/b][/u]
[b]Movement:[/b] W S A D
[b]Jump:[/b] Space
[b]Crouch:[/b] STRG
[b]Interaction:[/b] E
[b]Harvest:[/b] F
[b]Attack:[/b] Left Mouse Button
[b]Block:[/b] Right Mouse Button
[b]Roll:[/b] C
[b]Open Inventory:[/b] TAB
[b]Open Crafting:[/b] Left ALT
[b]Open Buildings:[/b] B
[b]Open Techtree:[/b] N
[b]Rotate items in Inventory:[/b] R
[b]Destroy buildings:[/b] R (pressed)
[b]Inspect Techtree:[/b] Middle Mouse Button

notes.title: G.E.T. Year Overview
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41941746/d7a17e717ee1e8ab1b9809fb29a33b13d557ed34.png[/img]


Dear pioneers,
Today there won't be a weekly update, but an overview of what we are planning for 2023 with G.E.T.

 We had planned to release the demo in December 2022. Unfortunately we couldn't achieve that, but we still want to stick to our goal of releasing a demo as soon as possible. We have set ourselves the next goal at the end of January and hope that nothing will get in our way until then, which means, that the date has to be postponed. However, we are confident, that we will achieve this, but want to be transparent with you, should there be any difficulties, because unfortunately G.E.T. can only be tackled as a part-time project. 
Further plans in 2023 are to launch a new Kickstarter campaign during the demo phase and if it should be successful, we will be able to give G.E.T. more time through the financial support. After the demo, we want to bring the game to an alpha state, where we have implemented most of the systems as well as your feedback from the demo. Depending on the feedback from the demo and the Kickstarter campaign, we will announce further plans. Until then, we would like to thank everyone who follows and supports us. It's not always easy, but every day you give us new energy, to realize our common dream of G.E.T.
Even though we had and will have many hurdles, we will not let them stop us from developing. 
Additionaly we would like to inform you, that we launched our first Patreon campaign for G.E.T to give you the opportunity to support us in our endavors. Here we are grateful for any support, as it makes us financially independent, which means, we can devote more time to G.E.T.
Thank you and Happy New Year 2023!

[url=patreon.com/get_the_game]Patreon[/url]
